evidence.reason: render_units recursively collects every template but flattens each to output / source.name without checking basename uniqueness. Distinct sources such as crq-repair.service and extra/crq-repair.service therefore render to the same output path; the later write overwrites the earlier unit and the returned paths contain duplicates while only one file remains. Rejecting duplicate basenames before writing is a small correctness repair and leaves unique-basename rendering unchanged.
